body: This PR does a lot more than just fixing a crash as the title would indicate. The description of your PR says this but you need to actually justify why. The glTF specification doesn't say to use a magenta checkerboard. This is a feature proposal, which shouldn't be tied together with a crash fix.
Ah I see, my bad. I'll look at this tonight to remove the feature and work on the bug fix only.
I opened PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109625 to fix the crash.
